reasons: Lake identity record exists for United States v. Garner, decided 2005-07-27 by the U.S. Court of Appeals, 10th Circuit.
Lake official citation is 416 F.3d 1208, with vendor-neutral citations 2005 U.S. App. LEXIS 15369 and 2005 WL 1766377; the payload matches those fields.

defect.evidence_quote: the government’s interest must outweigh the individual’s interest in being free from arbitrary governmental interference.
defect.locator_note: pin-1213a; slip-only; no validated position or fragment in the lake record.
defect.problem: The quoted rule sentence is substantively present, but it is not character-faithful to the cached opinion because the page quote uses straight apostrophes while the opinion uses curly apostrophes; the lake also marks this pin quote_fidelity as mismatch.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace with the exact opinion typography or record an explicit normalization rule for typographic apostrophes.

reasons: The cached opinion states the same sentence at the rule discussion, but with government’s and individual’s.
The payload quote uses government's and individual's, so it fails strict character-fidelity even though the rule itself is supported.
residual_risks: If this corpus treats typographic apostrophes as normalized, the defect is only editorial.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use the exact curly-apostrophe quote from the opinion text.

defect.evidence_quote: community caretaking detention must be based upon “‘specific and articulable facts which . . . reasonably warrant [an] intrusion’ into the individual’s liberty.”
defect.locator_note: pin-1213; lake marks quote_fidelity mismatch and has no position.
defect.problem: The pin-1213 quote in the lake/payload is not an opinion quote; it is a harvested chunk of the built content page beginning with page markup and background text.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-1213 with the actual opinion passage supporting the articulable-facts rule.

reasons: The payload quote begins with built-page markup, not the Garner opinion text.
The cached opinion contains the intended rule passage, but not the payload string.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Anchor this pin to the actual rule sentence at the community-caretaking test discussion.

defect.evidence_quote: Once the officer has completed the inquiry necessary to satisfy the purpose of the initial detention, he or she must allow the person to proceed unless the officer has a reasonable suspicion of criminal conduct.
defect.locator_note: pin-1213c; slip-only; no validated position or fragment in the lake record.
defect.problem: The quoted sentence is present in the cached opinion, but the lake marks it mismatch and supplies no validated position; in the cached text the sentence crosses a page break between “Once” and “the officer.”
defect.proposed_fix: Revalidate this pin against cleaned opinion text or store a validated position that tolerates pagination artifacts.

reasons: The word sequence appears in the cached opinion immediately after the tailoring sentence.
The lake nevertheless records quote_fidelity mismatch, apparently because the cached text has pagination between “Once” and “the officer.”
residual_risks: Strict raw-text character matching may continue to fail unless pagination is normalized.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the sentence but refresh the pin validation against pagination-normalized text.

reasons: The quoted tailoring sentence appears in the cached opinion’s rule discussion.
The lake marks pin-1213b quote_fidelity as matched and includes a validated fragment and position.
The payload treatment fields exactly match the disclosed lake treatment fields: good_law, as_of_content 2005-07-27, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, varies_by_point false, and the same scope note.
